limitations: ISO 13788:2012 monthly interstitial diffusion procedure with stored water, multiple condensation interfaces and exact within-month drying events.

Annual re-evaporation is not by itself a material-damage or runoff approval; interface maxima require construction-specific assessment.
WetInterfaces lists interfaces with nonzero stored water or mass transfer; all calculation interfaces remain identified in Grid.

limitations: ISO 13788:2012 clause-7 comparison starts with exactly 1 kg/m² excess water at the selected layer midpoint and repeats the explicitly supplied climate year for at most 120 months.
All interfaces are tracked; moving the water into another layer is not counted as drying the construction.
Drying time is the first completed monthly step with no remaining interface water; material degradation and runoff risks require separate review.
This is a standardized diffusion drying comparison, not a prediction of actual construction drying, a DIN 4108-3 verdict, or approval of supplied design data.
One-way affine slope towards a continuous low edge; every strip requires an explicitly supplied, dimensionally matching supplier SKU.
Supplier/manufacturer identity, catalogue revision and part data are user-supplied evidence, NOT independently verified product availability, approvals or certified characteristics.
Panel run and width are fixed per product range. Rectangular edge cuts are accounted as waste; offcuts are not reused. Pack rounding may add surplus whole boards.

Partition of a surveyed rectangle into adjacent one-way wedge fields, with collision, full-area and boundary-thickness checks.
Each field is calculated only against explicitly supplied supplier/revision/SKU data, without substituting unavailable stock.
Identical catalogue and SKU lines share pack-order rounding across fields; different revisions and sources are never merged.
No point drains, valley/saddle cutting, taper transformations, offcut reuse, penetrations or installation-sequence optimization.
Matching interface thickness does not verify waterproofing, falls, drainage capacity, wind uplift, statics or any manufacturer approval.
The result is a non-normative, unapproved estimate and must not be used as a binding fabrication or purchasing order.
